title: Systemic KPI Manipulation — Brazilian Regulatory Fraud via Case Fragmentation, Flight Data Irregularities, and GRU Operational Negligence

confidence.note: Pattern of case fragmentation and impossible connection scheduling is documented. ANAC’s prior investigation of LATAM for KPI manipulation (2023) establishes the practice. Case update rates this as HIGH strength, cross‑references BR‑013, BR‑014, BR‑019, BR‑020.

incident_timestamp_display: Ongoing from April 2024 (GRU) through 2025 (complaint handling). Key indicia: GRU operational negligence and subsequent SCL incident’s complaint fragmentation.
allegation_summary: LATAM systematically manipulated KPIs and regulatory metrics through: (1) fragmenting a single consumer incident into 8 separate case numbers, artificially improving complaint resolution statistics and hindering proper investigation; (2) maintaining operationally infeasible connection scheduling (e.g., the GRU‑GYN connection on 4 April 2024 was virtually impossible, guaranteeing a missed connection); and (3) exhibiting operational negligence at GRU that aligned with systematic procedural failures. ANAC had previously investigated LATAM for KPI manipulation in 2023, yet dismissed the passenger’s 2025 complaint covering the same practices, revealing inconsistent regulatory treatment. The abuse of case fragmentation and the creation of fraudulent connection metrics constitute an abusive practice under CDC Art. 39 and a violation of the principles of administrative morality and efficiency (Lei 9.784/99, Art. 2).
evidentiary_strength: HIGH. The 8‑case‑number fragmentation is verified; the impossible connection is corroborated by flight scheduling data; ANAC’s 2023 investigation is a matter of public record. Cross‑references align with case update.
legal_theory: Prática abusiva de fragmentação artificial de reclamações para manipulação de indicadores de qualidade, caracterizando fraude regulatória e violação dos deveres de transparência e boa‑fé.

legal_basis.article_name: CDC, Art. 39 – Vedação geral de práticas abusivas (caput) e incisos pertinentes (recusa de atendimento, vantagem excessiva, etc.)
Lei 9.784/99, Art. 2 – Princípios da Administração Pública, incluindo moralidade, razoabilidade e eficiência

note: Corrected and expanded BR‑018. Covers the systemic KPI manipulation. While the operational negligence occurred at GRU (I‑001), the case fragmentation and regulatory fraud relate to the handling of the SCL incident (I‑002). Cross‑references per comprehensive case update matrix.

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.translation_en: Is this your letter, Mr. Leandro?

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.translation_en: Is that my letter? Let me see.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: la latam declara que el dia el vuelo operado a asaya ocurrio un desvio a lo planificado, el motivo de lo ir fue denegacion de embarque.
full_segments.translation_en: Latam declares that on the day of the flight operated to Asaya there was a deviation from the plan, the reason for denial was denied boarding.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: se nega embarque por la siguiente razón, agresiona al personal de la latam, ingresa la aeronave sin autorización, no respeta la instrucción. ¿tú sabes que eso fue comprobado por la pdi, que eso no pasó?
full_segments.translation_en: Boarding denied for the following reason: aggression on Latam personnel, boarding the aircraft without authorization, not following instructions. Do you know that this was disproven by PDI, that it didn't happen?

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: esta es la carta que usted pidió. Señor, esa es la información que nosotros tenemos de lo sucedido. No podemos cambiar la información que tenemos. Señor, esa es la información que...
full_segments.translation_en: This is the letter you requested. Sir, that is the information we have of what happened. We cannot change the information we have. Sir, that is the information that...

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Yo estoy preguntando si tiene pruebas para eso.
full_segments.translation_en: I am asking if you have proof for that.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: La carta yo pedí lo que pasó. Estas son las acusaciones que fueron desprobadas..
full_segments.translation_en: The letter I asked for what happened. These are the accusations that were disproven.

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: No me grite porque yo no lo estoy viendo. Yo no estoy gritando. Le voy a pedir que no lo haga.
full_segments.translation_en: Don't yell at me because I am not seeing it. I am not yelling. I am going to ask you not to.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: y la entrada, ingresar a la aeronave sin autorización, si ustedes tienen alguna prueba para eso? Ah, entonces, ¿quién llegó a esa conclusión entonces?
full_segments.translation_en: And the entry, boarding the aircraft without authorization, if you have any proof for that? Ah, then who came to that conclusion then?

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Eso lo vamos a ver en el área legal. Ellos tienen en este momento las imágenes y las demandas de salida.
full_segments.translation_en: That we'll see in the legal area. They currently have the images and departure claims.

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Eso lo tiene que ver después con el área legal cuando lo contacten. Eso no lo vemos nosotros, lo ve el área legal.
full_segments.translation_en: You have to see that later with the legal area when they contact you. We don't see that, the legal area sees it.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: yo como pasajero, como cliente, me quedo botado sin mi pasaje, prohibido de volar a la latam.
full_segments.translation_en: I as a passenger, as a client, I am left stranded without my ticket, prohibited from flying Latam.

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Segundo la informacion que tenemos nosotros no le podemos dar otra opción.
full_segments.translation_en: According to the information we have, we cannot give you another option.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.translation_en: Good night. Thank you very much.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Duty to Provide Truthful Information (Consumer Law Art. 30)
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPC.Art.30 and confirm obligation to inform truthfully in consumer relations.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: El artículo 30 de la Ley N°19.496 sobre Protección de los Derechos de los Consumidores establece la obligación del proveedor de informar veraz y oportunamente al consumidor. Al entregar una carta con acusaciones falsas o no verificadas sobre el pasajero, LATAM podría estar incumpliendo dicho deber de información veraz.
candidate_articles.history_note: Analogous to BR.CDC.T1.C5.Art.39 but under Chilean consumer law.

verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CC.Art.2314 and confirm applicability to false accusations causing moral damage.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: El artículo 2314 del Código Civil dispone que quien comete un delito o cuasidelito que cause daño a otro está obligado a indemnizar. La conducta de LATAM al imputar hechos falsos podría constituir un ilícito civil que, de acreditarse, generaría responsabilidad extracontractual por el daño moral sufrido por el pasajero.
candidate_articles.history_note: Selected as a foundational tort provision in Chilean civil law.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Data Accuracy Obligation (Data Protection Law Art. 7)

Si LATAM mantiene en sus registros acusaciones falsas sobre el pasajero, estaría infringiendo el principio de calidad del dato, pudiendo dar lugar a reclamación conforme a esta ley.
